skill.core.mysticism.description.advance:
{Advanced Mysticism}

Regenerates {20%} of maximum spell points per day, with a {minimum of 10 spell points}.

{Mystic Momentum}: successfully casting selected adventure-map control spells grants additional movement {on the next day}, {once per spell per day}.

Bonuses: {Fly +10}, {Town Portal +15}, {Dimension Door +20}, {Water Walk +40}, {Summon Boat +30}, {Scuttle Boat +30}.
